sources.entry: bindPDF - Combine multiple PDF files into a single PDF file using a friendly UI. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/vishaltelangre/bindPDF) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: bindPDF is a macOS app that merges multiple PDF files into a single PDF through a simple graphical interface.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes bindPDF as a Mac application for combining several PDF files into one PDF. It is distributed as a DMG archive containing bindPDF.app, which is dragged into the Applications folder. A video walkthrough of installation and use is linked, but the README does not describe specific merge options or features beyond combining files. The project is an Xcode project (bindPDF.xcodeproj), so it can be built and run locally from source. The README is brief and gives no feature list.
use_cases: merge multiple PDF files into one
combine scanned pages or documents into a single PDF
bind PDFs together without the command line
prepare a single PDF for sharing or printing
how_to_run: Download the latest DMG archive from the releases page
Extract the DMG and move bindPDF.app into the Applications folder
To build from source: open bindPDF.xcodeproj in Xcode
Press cmd (⌘) + R to build and run locally
notable: Graphical UI for merging PDFs, no command line needed
Distributed as a DMG app bundle for drag-and-drop installation
Source available as an Xcode project for local builds
Video walkthrough linked in the README
caveats: Targets macOS only; the README names no other platforms
README gives little detail on features or supported PDF variants
